headline: Names a Philadelphia post office building after Sergeant Christopher David Fitzgerald.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 9925 Bustleton Avenue in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The building will be called the Sergeant Christopher David Fitzgerald Post Office Building. It does not change how mail is handled or any rules for postal customers.
when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was signed into law on November 25, 2024.
